## Checklist

- [ ] Unit tests cover validation, encoding/decoding, and reply-shape failures
- [ ] A live Redis integration test exists if behavior depends on command or reply semantics
- [ ] Docs pages under `docs/src/content/docs/` are updated if behavior changed
- [ ] A changeset is added for user-visible changes (`pnpm changeset`)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
